games.name: Who's the Spy?
games.desc:
👍 LIKE the game and join the group to get Free Baby High Chair and Reveal Spy!

👑 Create private server and play with friends to get Free Admin Commands.
🎮 Admin Commands: Set how many spies, set who will be the spies, set who will create the secret words.

How to Play:
🎲 You will be given a random secret word.
💬 Describe the word in a general manner but never tell the exact word. Anyone can be a spy.
🕵️‍♂️ Find out who is the spy and kick out of the game to win!

INNOCENTS: Help each other to know who is the spy. Vote the possible spy to eliminate.
SPY: Pretend like you are not spy, eliminate all innocents and stay throughout the game to win.

💬 Earn wins and coins to roll cool chairs, purchase tables and unlock colorful text colors, background colors, font styles.

⭐ 2 Game Modes to have fun
Wordless Spy: The spy does not know the secret word of innocents but aware he is the spy.
Spy with Word: The spy has different secret word compared to innocents but clueless he is the spy.
